enforcementEvents.checker: designated CSIRT coordinator and market-surveillance authorities
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: actively exploited vulnerability or severe incident notification
enforcementEvents.trigger: manufacturer awareness of a reportable vulnerability or incident
enforcementEvents.mechanism: 24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, and final report through ENISA SRP
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: non-compliance with CRA reporting obligation; no observed operator rejection code collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: submit or complete the required notification
enforcementEvents.sla: 24 hours, 72 hours, then event-specific final-report deadline

enforcementEvents.checkedObject: catch certificate and related import documents
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: unknown; no primary rejection code or blocked-shipment receipt collected in this run

enforcementEvents.checker: DGFiP registration service and accredited platforms
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: regulated invoice transmission and transaction or payment reporting
enforcementEvents.trigger: business transmission or receipt of a regulated electronic invoice
enforcementEvents.mechanism: only accredited platforms may transmit the regulated flows; registration is monitored and renewable
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: non-accredited compatible software cannot perform the regulated transmission; repeated accredited-platform breaches may cause financial sanction or registration withdrawal
enforcementEvents.remedy: route through an accredited platform and conform to published formats, lifecycle statuses, and API standards
enforcementEvents.financialConsequence: financial sanctions are possible, but no quantified consequence was collected in this run

enforcementEvents.checker: RTO or ISO transmission provider under FERC-directed tariff reform
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: large-load project identity, site control, and escalating commercial readiness
enforcementEvents.trigger: entry into and progression through transmission study phases
enforcementEvents.mechanism: objective readiness evidence intended to deter duplicative or speculative service requests
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: project may fail a readiness gate or leave the study process; uniform production rejection codes were not collected

enforcementEvents.checker: manufacturer, qualified conformity assessor, or market-surveillance authority as applicable
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: risk assessment and conformity evidence for a physical or digital machinery modification
enforcementEvents.trigger: an unplanned modification may create a new hazard or increase an existing risk and requires new protective measures
enforcementEvents.mechanism: the modifying party can assume manufacturer obligations and must apply the relevant conformity-assessment procedure
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: the modified machinery may lack valid conformity evidence; no case-level enforcement receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: perform the applicable risk assessment and conformity procedure under qualified authority

enforcementEvents.checker: competent F-gas authority, customs or market-surveillance authority, and qualified laboratory as applicable
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: container label, batch and reclamation-facility identity, chain of custody, and physical refrigerant composition
enforcementEvents.trigger: placing reclaimed or recycled fluorinated greenhouse gas on the market or asserting reclaimed status
enforcementEvents.mechanism: EU labeling and quota rules establish documentary status while prescribed analytical testing establishes purity
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: documentary status or physical composition may fail; no regulator case or rejected batch receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: correct chain-of-custody records and obtain qualified batch analysis; do not infer purity from mass balance

enforcementEvents.checker: U.S. Food and Drug Administration and authorized trading partners
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: interoperable electronic package-level transaction information, statements, verification, and exception handling
enforcementEvents.trigger: a defined small dispenser or its applicable trading partner transacts covered prescription drug product after the exemption ends
enforcementEvents.mechanism: DSCSA statutory duties, FDA exemption boundary, EPCIS exchange, investigation, quarantine, correction, and illegitimate-product notification
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: noncompliant or unreconciled physical/data transaction; no case-level rejection or enforcement receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: resolve the trading-partner or product-data exception under authorized compliance and quality procedures

enforcementEvents.checker: qualified conformity assessment body and ISO/IEC 17025-capable analytical laboratory
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: final drinking-water contact material composition, test piece, migration water, analytical results, and acceptance criteria
enforcementEvents.trigger: placing an in-scope product or material for a new drinking-water installation or repair on the market under the harmonized hygiene rules
enforcementEvents.mechanism: positive-list screening followed by prescribed risk-based migration testing, analysis, and pass/fail assessment
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: composition or migration criteria fail; no product-level laboratory or conformity receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: reformulate, resubmit representative test material, and obtain qualified test and conformity evidence

enforcementEvents.checker: SoHO entity and competent authority under applicable national reproductive-donation rules
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: donor registry history, national offspring or application limits, cross-border distribution, and serious genetic-condition notification
enforcementEvents.trigger: repeated donation, cross-border reproductive SoHO distribution, or a serious genetic condition detected in donor-conceived offspring
enforcementEvents.mechanism: entity or national registries, case-by-case interconnected checks, vigilance communication, and competent-authority inspection
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: unsafe repeat donation, exceeded national limit, or delayed genetic-risk action; no case-level receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: stop implicated distribution, investigate through authorized entities, and comply with national identity, data-protection, and family-limit rules
enforcementEvents.sla: serious genetic-condition information is communicated without undue delay; no numeric operational SLA was collected

enforcementEvents.checkedObject: responsible-business, cybersecurity, data-security, delivery, sustainability, and resilience prequalification or award evidence
enforcementEvents.trigger: participation in an in-scope renewable-energy deployment auction
enforcementEvents.mechanism: national auction documents apply the Net-Zero Industry Act non-price prequalification and award criteria under Commission rules and guidance
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: bid can fail prequalification or lose non-price award scoring; no rejected bid or award receipt was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: satisfy the specific auction authority's evidence and correction process

enforcementEvents.checker: Member State competent authorities, courts, and affected persons or their representatives
enforcementEvents.checkedObject: authorized human oversight, explanation, review, rectification, and decisions of equivalent detriment in digital platform work
enforcementEvents.trigger: an automated monitoring or decision system affects a person performing platform work, including account or contractual restrictions, suspension, termination, pay, or essential contractual aspects
enforcementEvents.mechanism: national transposition must require competent and authorized human oversight, access to explanation and review, and a sufficiently precise and substantiated response within two weeks
enforcementEvents.failureStatus: rights infringement or non-compliance can require rectification or adequate compensation; no operator case or national penalty was collected
enforcementEvents.remedy: provide authorized human review and rectify the decision without delay and within the applicable two-week boundary where required
enforcementEvents.sla: substantiated review response within two weeks; rectification without delay and in any case within two weeks after the review decision
enforcementEvents.financialConsequence: adequate compensation where rectification is not possible; amount is case-specific and unknown

milestones.label: CRA vulnerability and incident reporting applies
milestones.buyerImplication: Manufacturers need a working reporting and evidence workflow before general CRA application

milestones.label: Member States apply the repair directive
milestones.buyerImplication: After-sales obligations move from preparation into national implementation

milestones.label: European Repair Platform expected operational during 2027; exact date not established
milestones.buyerImplication: Generic repair discovery features face direct public-platform absorption

milestones.label: France first B2B e-invoicing and e-reporting wave
milestones.buyerImplication: Large taxpayers enter cutover in an already dense accredited-platform ecosystem

milestones.label: ViDA cross-border B2B e-invoicing and digital reporting
milestones.buyerImplication: Cross-border standardisation increases while country-specific transition work persists

milestones.label: CATCH compulsory for EU importer submissions
milestones.buyerImplication: The market is past migration; exception and rejection evidence is now the critical unknown

milestones.label: Key EHDS implementing acts due in March 2027; exact day not established
milestones.buyerImplication: Preflight product requirements remain unstable until detailed operational rules land

milestones.label: Secondary-use rules apply to most data categories in March 2029; exact day not established
milestones.buyerImplication: Commercial urgency is later than present infrastructure preparation

milestones.label: New Telematics Applications TSI enters into force
milestones.buyerImplication: Passenger and freight actors move from separate legacy telematics specifications into a shared migration and interoperability programme

milestones.label: FERC issues large-load show-cause orders on readiness and speculative requests
milestones.buyerImplication: A neutral readiness product must interoperate with utility-owned gates rather than claim authority over queue admission

milestones.label: Council and Parliament reach provisional Critical Medicines Act agreement
milestones.buyerImplication: Resilience criteria are politically agreed but the formal rule and buyer implementation boundary are not yet final

milestones.label: Critical Medicines Act formal adoption; exact date not established
milestones.buyerImplication: Only final text can establish the durable procurement evidence boundary

milestones.label: European Commission publishes EU Space Act proposal; exact June day not established in the retained factsheet
milestones.buyerImplication: Lifecycle risk and sustainability evidence are emerging requirements, not yet a live uniform gate

milestones.label: IRIS2 governmental service targeted for 2030; exact date not established
milestones.buyerImplication: A concentrated prime-led programme creates subcontract assurance demand but a narrow channel and strong incumbent control

milestones.label: EU Data Act generally applies
milestones.buyerImplication: Connected-product users can seek readily available raw and pre-processed data, but OEM-specific access and semantics still determine implementation cost

milestones.label: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol and complementary agent-payment specifications are publicly documented
milestones.buyerImplication: A startup must interoperate with emerging trust and authorization standards and prove a distinct B2B supplier-workflow gap

milestones.label: European Commission adopts a voluntary charter for industrial access to research and technology infrastructures in July 2026; exact day not established
milestones.buyerImplication: Public coordination is improving discoverability and access practice, while scientific review, safety, contracts, IP, and facility authority remain outside a generic router

milestones.label: EU eForms became mandatory for procurement notices in October 2023; exact day not retained in this run
milestones.buyerImplication: Tender discovery and normalization increasingly rest on public machine-readable schemas rather than scarce proprietary extraction

milestones.label: Verification of Payee applies to non-euro-area payment service providers
milestones.buyerImplication: Scheme-owned conformance testing is available before cutover; an independent product must prove cross-provider production exceptions beyond the reference toolbox

milestones.label: EU Data Act cloud and data-processing switching charges are removed
milestones.buyerImplication: Egress-fee removal reduces one barrier but leaves technical, architectural, licensing, signing, and operational-continuity work to customers and providers

milestones.label: Regulation EU 2023/1230 becomes mandatorily applicable
milestones.buyerImplication: Machine builders and operators need an evidence path from digital or physical change through risk assessment and any required conformity reassessment

milestones.label: Regulation EU 2026/1738 adopted and published in the Official Journal
milestones.buyerImplication: Dismantlers can prepare evidence systems against a final legal text rather than a proposal, while later application dates preserve a preparation window

milestones.label: General Regulation EU 2026/1738 application expected after its 24-month preparation period
milestones.buyerImplication: Authorized treatment facilities have a bounded preparation period to capture removal, condition, feasibility, and treatment evidence

milestones.label: Covered EU batteries require a battery passport
milestones.buyerImplication: Second-life operators gain role-controlled information but still need physical qualification, responsibility transfer, liability, and transaction evidence

milestones.label: Member States establish covered pharmaceutical and cosmetics wastewater EPR
milestones.buyerImplication: Country-specific approved PROs, contribution rules, producer data, guarantees, and utility payment mechanisms must exist before a settlement product can be tested

milestones.label: FDA small-dispenser DSCSA exemptions end for defined eligible dispensers
milestones.buyerImplication: Small dispensers and applicable partners must complete electronic package-level tracing while distinguishing GS1 message conformance from local physical and operational readiness

milestones.label: EU positive-list and hygiene rules apply to in-scope drinking-water contact materials and products
milestones.buyerImplication: Manufacturers and laboratories need confidential composition intake, list checks, representative test plans, migration analysis, and conformity evidence before cutover

milestones.label: Main Regulation EU 2024/1938 and EU SoHO Platform implementing rules apply
milestones.buyerImplication: SoHO entities and authorities must prepare authenticated platform and vigilance workflows while reproductive family-limit rules remain national

milestones.label: Net-Zero Industry Act renewable-auction non-price obligations apply
milestones.buyerImplication: Bidders must satisfy authority-specific non-price prequalification and award evidence rather than relying only on bid price

milestones.label: Member States transpose Directive EU 2024/2831 into national law
milestones.buyerImplication: Digital labour platforms must prepare jurisdiction-specific human-oversight, explanation, review, worker-representation, rectification, and evidence workflows
